principles: Badge progression may express audience practice, participation, professional practice, reputation and influence without creating employment.
Formal employment is represented only by explicit career_offer metadata and remains separate from life position state.
Frilansjournalist is professional journalistic practice, but freelance income belongs to livelihood/assignment flows rather than a fixed Badge salary.
Editorial leadership titles require a concrete employer appointment before they can become active positions.
Reputation and public influence never grant editorial authority, employment or salary by themselves.

sources.title: Journalist
supports: Journalist is a real occupation centered on gathering, evaluating and communicating information through editorial media.
The occupational registry connected to the page includes Journalist, freelancejournalist and redaksjonell medarbeider as real work titles.

sources.title: Redaktør
supports: A redaktør leads editorial work and decides what is published.
The role carries overarching professional and ethical responsibility and normally legal responsibility for published content.

sources.title: Norsk Journalistlags program
supports: NJ explicitly distinguishes employees from freelancers and self-employed journalists.
Freelance work is compensated through assignments/honoraria and has separate working-condition concerns.

sources.title: Journalistavtalen for Bauer — frilansavtale
supports: The agreement defines a freelance journalist as someone who is not employed as an editorial worker and instead performs journalistic assignments for one or more media outlets.
This supports modelling freelance journalism as professional practice/livelihood rather than a fixed Badge salary job.

notes: Kommentator (felt) and Bidragsyter remain useful Media identities, but the generic labels are too broad to create employment automatically.
Frilansjournalist remains a professional identity and can receive explicit livelihood assignments without becoming a fixed-salary active position.
Redaktør, Sjefredaktør and Nyhetsleder require employer appointment because Badge points cannot grant editorial authority.
Medieprofil, Mediestjerne, Offentlig dagsordensetter and Offentlighetsmakt are reputation/influence states only.

salary_mapping.principle: salary_tier selects existing Civication game-economy bands only and is not a claim about Norwegian market salary.
